ayahOccurrences.text: ٱذْهَبْ أَنتَ وَأَخُوكَ بِـَٔايَٰتِى وَلَا تَنِيَا فِى ذِكْرِى
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: ٱذْهَبْ أَنتَ وَأَخُوكَ بِـَٔايَٰتِى وَلَا تَنِيَا فِى ذِكْرِى

lexSnapshot.wordGrammar: 2nd person dual imperfect verb, jussive mood
lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: تَنِيَا is in the derivative form: تَنِي
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
و/ن/ي   w–n–y place of rest, relaxation; slackness, weakness; to delay; shortcoming, delaying; docks. Of this root, تَنِيَا taniyā, occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
تَنِي tanı [imperf. of وَنِيَ waniya, intrans.] to be slack, to be neg‐ ligent

(20:42) وَلاَ تَنِيَا فِى ذِكْرِي and never be lax in remembering Me.
